cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.

mechanism: A directs access to a home and changes visiting terms to fit B work, pricing further access and help in food and time together.
confusable: Unlike a neutral property collection, closeness and assistance become a tariff; borrowed authority keeps B cooperating by accepting alternative payment.
comparison: Collecting records through shared lunch differs from support at an exhibition as the price of forgiveness.
seedUse: Use D94-b key/Sunday/Saturday/records/lunch with S02-b practical accommodation in a controlled negotiation.
